items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Preston Jackson was on trombone, and Eddie Fante was on trombone.

ctx.x: You were talking about the Sunset All Stars. And you said that Jabbo Smith was in there, and Zinky Zooty Singleton. Was Preston Jackson in the band?
Preston Jackson was on trombone, and Eddie Fante was on trombone.
